name: Tekkonkinkreet painterly urban
summary: A dense, hand-painted, ramshackle pan-Asian city as the star: wobbly naive line, warped perspective, saturated rust, teal and neon, every surface covered in signs and clutter.

traits.line: Loose, wobbly, slightly naive pen line from Taiyo Matsumoto's manga; uneven weights; doodle-like.
traits.shading: Flat fills with minimal shadow on figures; heavy painted modelling in backgrounds.
traits.palette: Saturated, warm and dirty: rust orange, teal, mustard, red lanterns, faded posters; neon greens and pinks at night.
traits.lighting: Golden late-afternoon haze, neon night glow, warm lantern light.
traits.faces: Scrappy, asymmetric, childlike faces with small eyes, big ears and odd proportions.
traits.backgrounds: Hyper-dense hand-painted city: tangled wires, signage, laundry, shrines, crumbling Showa facades and Ganesh statues (Tokyo, Hong Kong, Shanghai, Colombo blended); warped wide-angle perspective.
traits.texture: Painterly brush texture, grime, opaque poster paint; impressionist watercolour in dream sequences.
traits.camera: Swooping CG-assisted camera through painted streets, wide fisheye angles, rooftop flight.

style_words: Hand-painted urban animation: loose wobbly naive pen lines with flat minimal shading, set against hyper-dense painted backgrounds of crumbling Showa facades, tangled wires, lanterns and faded signage, warped wide-angle perspective, saturated rust orange, teal and mustard with neon night glow, gritty brush texture, as in Tekkonkinkreet (2006).

krea2.style: Hand-painted urban animation, as in Tekkonkinkreet: loose wobbly naive pen lines of uneven weight, scrappy asymmetric faces with small eyes and big ears, flat minimal shading on figures, hyper-dense painted backgrounds of crumbling facades, tangled wires and lanterns, warped perspective, rust orange, teal and mustard, gritty brush texture.
krea2.recap: Rendered throughout as hand-painted urban animation with loose wobbly pen lines and gritty brush texture.

flux3_klein.style: Hand-painted urban anime in the register of Tekkonkinkreet: loose, wobbly, naive pen lines of uneven weight, scrappy asymmetric faces with small eyes and big ears, flat fills with minimal shadow on the figures, hyper-dense painted backgrounds with heavy modelling, crumbling surfaces and dense hand-painted clutter, warped wide-angle perspective, painterly brush texture, grime and opaque poster paint.
flux3_klein.recap: Rust orange, teal and mustard fill the walls, the ground and the sky, red appears only in lamp and flame light, neon green and pink appear only as a night glow around the light sources, the shadow fills are a dirty dark teal, and every garment keeps its own stated colour.

qwen_image_2_1.style: The image is a hand-painted animation frame in a signature Tekkonkinkreet style, with loose, wobbly, slightly naive pen lines of uneven weight, flat fills with minimal shadow on figures, heavily painted modelling in the surroundings, warped wide-angle perspective, painterly brush texture, grime and opaque poster paint, depicting a scene from a Gothic Victorian novel in a palette of saturated, warm and dirty rust orange, teal and mustard, with red lantern tones and neon green and pink glow.
qwen_image_2_1.recap: The overall composition packs its frame with dense painted detail bent by warped wide-angle perspective in golden haze, in a scrappy, vivid mood, keeps to a palette of saturated, warm and dirty rust orange, teal and mustard, with red lantern tones and neon green and pink glow, and reads throughout as a hand-painted animation frame in a signature Tekkonkinkreet style, with loose, wobbly, slightly naive pen lines of uneven weight, flat fills with minimal shadow on figures, heavily painted modelling in the surroundings, warped wide-angle perspective, painterly brush texture, grime and opaque poster paint.
